scope: Final offline source/native copper/CAM/schematic/native mechanical review only. Passed geometric/software checks do not qualify electrical operation, motor torque, USB programming, thermal margin, supplier assembly or fabrication release.

bindings.compiler_warning_record_difference: 23 source warning records are emitted by compilation and omitted by saved-board sync; functional source/schematic records are canonically identical.

cam_software.note: The CLI embeds its own Gerber converter; actual Gerber metadata is authoritative and can differ from the separately installed package version.

cloud_install.scope: Installed development workflow; occurred before later metadata-only bare insertion update.

warnings.message: Q_DATA has no pin with requires_power=true

saved_board_native_drc.warning_disposition: Generic native imported NPN has no VDD pin; keep true warning instead of fabricating a power pin.

placement.disposition: Nonzero exit for unrouted airwire crossing/rotation advice. Same advice on accepted saved-board; source geometrical DRC0/0, actual source+CAM routing separately checked.

official_cli.previousJsonNetlistAttempt: Unsupported JSON input for netlist produced React array type error; final command uses TSX entrypoint.

official_cli_placement_advisories.disposition: Airwire orientation suggestions repeat on accepted saved copper. No schematic/PCB placement CLI blanket PASS claimed. Actual native pads, routed connectivity and CAM are separately audited.

independent_cam.scope: Parsed actual Gerber/Excellon/ZIP, native pads/polygons/slots, paste/mask/drills/BOM/CPL and independent renders. Supplier production process acceptance remains pending.

native_schematic.official_ide_limitation: Official IDE attempt recorded disabled schematic tab for saved JSON and unavailable WebGPU adapter. Native project review UI and actual CLI provide separately identified review evidence; no claim of official IDE analyzer completion.

native_mechanical.scope: Native imported component STEP and official motor STEP; nominal analysis, separate prototype carrier. Maximum bulk-cap envelope separately screened; actual package/cable/carrier fabrication untested.

deterministic_electrical_calculations.scope: Datasheet arithmetic and explicit scenarios; driver accuracy, temperature and transient qualification excluded.

release_risks.finding: A4988 regulation accuracy is not specified at the selected ~0.6735V reference. Formula-only nominal phase limit0.350765A and provisional component upper value0.379245A do not include driver accuracy. No qualified maximum current claim.
release_risks.resolution: Scope phase/sense peak current over temperature/supply/decay/microstep states; satisfy motor0.4A per-phase limit with margin or change hardware.

release_risks.finding: Protected VM ADC switch/NPN host detection are implemented, but intermediate-rail behavior, fast collapse and charged10nF discharge are unqualified; VM OE must remain HIGH until rail valid. Firmware absent. PD-only ROM/pull-up ESD ghost-DATA and false active-low host detection are a specific untested boundary.
release_risks.resolution: Scope all PD/DATA connection/removal/order/ramp/brownout conditions at MCU pins and VDD; verify exact absolute limits, obtain manufacturer injection guidance, or add guaranteed hardware supervision/clamps.

release_risks.finding: HT7533-1 exact primary output/input/stability/thermal specifications and mounted thermal margin remain unverified; A4988/motor/sense temperatures and ground current sharing unmeasured.
release_risks.resolution: Obtain exact primary specifications, derating and selected-package evidence; run worst-case mounted thermal soak or replace unqualified power architecture.

release_risks.finding: Exact selected TVS clamp/energy, ESD device and NPN primary limits, resistor pulse/hot tolerance and ceramic effective capacitance remain incomplete. Regenerative motor/load energy is unqualified.
release_risks.resolution: Complete exact-MPN primary evidence and transient/ripple/temperature qualification; revise protection if required.

release_risks.finding: Official motor drawing specifies front M3 threads, not independent rear mounting holes. Native rear recesses contain endcap fasteners. Separate front-thread carrier is a machined prototype candidate only.
release_risks.resolution: Prototype carrier/fasteners and qualify actual motor revision, thread engagement, load strength, cable exit and isolation; do not remove endcap fasteners for PCB mounting.

release_risks.finding: Native C178585 bulk capacitor STEP is5.82mm tall while manufacturer body height is7.7±0.3mm. Native model retained; independent manufacturer-maximum envelope screened.
release_risks.resolution: Verify actual production package and assembly clearance with correct supplier model or physical sample.

release_risks.finding: Both USB-C mouths face+Y atX±5.3mm, pitch10.6mm; compact overmolds≤10mm are a screening requirement. Physical simultaneous insertion/retention/strain relief not tested.
release_risks.resolution: Use actual intended compact PD/DATA cables and assembled carrier to qualify mating/retention/bend/fastener clearance.

release_risks.finding: Offline native/CAM audits pass their geometric scope; fab mask/stencil/annulus process acceptance and supplier CPL rotation/pickup orientation are not verified. No stock/price quote or assembly preview approval.
release_risks.resolution: Supplier reviews actual ZIP/BOM/CPL and package pick-up conventions; resolve mask/stencil policy and approve preview before any order.

release_risks.finding: USB hardware paths and boot/debug interfaces exist; firmware/protocol and actual USB enumeration/programming/motion have not been demonstrated.
release_risks.resolution: Implement correct reset-safe active-low host detection and VM OE sequencing, firmware flashing/USB control, then run bring-up checklist.

approvals: No fabrication, assembly-placement, final-price, payment or engineering sign-off approval is inferred or recorded.
freshness_rule: Any changes to these bound source/package/pin/placement/copper/CAM/native model records require reassessment and new evidence bindings; old artifacts and logs are not reused as proof of a different revision.

publication_preparation.changes: Package staging preserves authoritative JSON/version files; pins distributed CAD URLs to uploaded Git commit and includes exact saved dist Circuit JSON. Electrical/native footprint/Cu/CAM inputs unchanged.
publication_preparation.upload_policy: Compact exact Circuit JSON; source, A4 SVGs and assembly metadata in compressed registry archive. Full CAM/CAD/review evidence remains on GitHub.
